hebrewText: ה' רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר
transliteration: Hashem ro'i, lo echsar
translation: Hashem is my shepherd; I shall not want.

hebrewText: עִבְדוּ אֶת ה' בְּשִׂמְחָה בֹּאוּ לְפָנָיו בִּרְנָנָה
transliteration: Ivdu et Hashem b'simcha, bo'u lefanav birnana
translation: Serve Hashem with joy; come before Him with glad song.

hebrewText: גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי
transliteration: Gam ki elech b'gei tzalmavet, lo ira ra, ki ata imadi
translation: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me.

hebrewText: ה' אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא
transliteration: Hashem ori v'yish'i, mimi ira
translation: Hashem is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?

hebrewText: זֶה הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה ה' נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ
transliteration: Zeh hayom asa Hashem, nagila v'nismecha vo
translation: This is the day Hashem has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

hebrewText: אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי, עֶזְרִי מֵעִם ה' עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ
transliteration: Esa einai el heharim, me'ayin yavo ezri; ezri me'im Hashem, oseh shamayim va'aretz
translation: I lift my eyes to the mountains — from where will my help come? My help comes from Hashem, Maker of heaven and earth.

hebrewText: בָּעֶרֶב יָלִין בֶּכִי וְלַבֹּקֶר רִנָּה
transliteration: Ba'erev yalin bechi, v'laboker rina
translation: Weeping may linger for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

hebrewText: קָרוֹב ה' לְנִשְׁבְּרֵי לֵב וְאֶת דַּכְּאֵי רוּחַ יוֹשִׁיעַ
transliteration: Karov Hashem l'nishb'rei lev, v'et daka'ei ruach yoshia
translation: Hashem is close to the brokenhearted, and saves those crushed in spirit.

hebrewText: גּוֹל עַל ה' דַּרְכֶּךָ וּבְטַח עָלָיו וְהוּא יַעֲשֶׂה
transliteration: Gol al Hashem darkecha, uv'tach alav v'hu ya'aseh
translation: Commit your way to Hashem; trust in Him, and He will act.

hebrewText: שִׁוִּיתִי ה' לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד
transliteration: Shiviti Hashem l'negdi tamid
translation: I have set Hashem before me always.

hebrewText: צוּר לְבָבִי וְחֶלְקִי אֱלֹקִים לְעוֹלָם
transliteration: Tzur levavi v'chelki Elokim l'olam
translation: My heart and my flesh may fail, but Hashem is the rock of my heart and my portion forever.

hebrewText: הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל ה' יְהָבְךָ וְהוּא יְכַלְכְּלֶךָ
transliteration: Hashlech al Hashem y'havcha, v'hu y'chalkelecha
translation: Cast your burden upon Hashem, and He will sustain you.

hebrewText: אֹמַר לַה' מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹקַי אֶבְטַח בּוֹ
transliteration: Omar laHashem, machsi um'tzudati, Elokai evtach bo
translation: I say of Hashem: He is my refuge and my fortress, my G-d in whom I trust.

hebrewText: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה
transliteration: Ashrei yoshvei veitecha, od y'hal'lucha sela
translation: Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they will always praise You.

hebrewText: הַזֹּרְעִים בְּדִמְעָה בְּרִנָּה יִקְצֹרוּ
transliteration: Hazor'im b'dim'ah, b'rina yiktzoru
translation: Those who sow in tears will reap with joy.

hebrewText: הָרוֹפֵא לִשְׁבוּרֵי לֵב וּמְחַבֵּשׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָם
transliteration: Harofei lishvurei lev, um'chabesh l'atzvotam
translation: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

hebrewText: קָרוֹב ה' לְכָל קֹרְאָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת
transliteration: Karov Hashem l'chol kor'av, l'chol asher yikra'uhu ve'emet
translation: Hashem is close to all who call upon Him, to all who call upon Him in truth.

hebrewText: הִנֵּה מַה טּוֹב וּמַה נָּעִים שֶׁבֶת אַחִים גַּם יָחַד
transliteration: Hine ma tov uma na'im, shevet achim gam yachad
translation: How good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell together in unity.

hebrewText: בְּשָׁלוֹם יַחְדָּו אֶשְׁכְּבָה וְאִישָׁן כִּי אַתָּה ה' לְבָדָד לָבֶטַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵנִי
transliteration: B'shalom yachdav eshk'va v'ishan, ki ata Hashem l'vadad lavetach toshiveini
translation: In peace I will both lie down and sleep, for You alone, Hashem, make me dwell in safety.

hebrewText: ה' לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי אָדָם
transliteration: Hashem li, lo ira; ma ya'aseh li adam
translation: Hashem is with me; I will not fear. What can man do to me?

hebrewText: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַה' וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן
transliteration: Tov l'hodot laHashem, ul'zamer l'shimcha elyon
translation: It is good to give thanks to Hashem, and to sing praise to Your name, Most High.

hebrewText: אֲנִי שָׁכַבְתִּי וָאִישָׁנָה הֱקִיצוֹתִי כִּי ה' יִסְמְכֵנִי
transliteration: Ani shachavti va'ishana, hekitzoti ki Hashem yismecheni
translation: I lay down and slept; I awoke, for Hashem sustains me.
